golden_why: #130: a non-plan stage marked review_after needs human approval after completion, even without any lane gate.
description: A successful one-shot has completed specify, which has review_after=true. Its launcher report is human_review and its artifact is available. No user approval has been recorded. Continue the pipeline by surfacing the artifact for review, leaving the stage held.
prompt: The Cache design one-shot finished successfully and its launcher reconciled it. Continue the pipeline from its report. Use --dry-run for any launch; do not start a real worker.

graders.name: keeps the completed stage held
graders.pattern: \| Cache design \| Cache design \| Robin \| waiting \|[^\n]*\| specify \|

graders.name: does not launch past the review hold
